criteria.title: A record of another tenant, a body outside the schema, a lead without an office, a kind the CRM does not take and the 61st in a minute are refused before any CRM call
tests: submissions another tenant’s record, a body outside the schema, a lead without an office, a kind the CRM does not take and the 61st in a minute are refused before any CRM call
submissions a Core that is not the live service refuses every form before any CRM call, and the visitor reads that it was not sent
submissions the site’s server reads the bot check’s key, and a form without the window’s proof or with a failed one is refused before any CRM call, as is every form on a live Core without the check
criteria.note: 400 for the other tenant's record, a record Core does not hold, a value off the whitelist, a consent not given and an unknown field; 400 for a lead without office_id once the tenant has two offices; 501 from the fake webhook CRM, which lists no submissions; 429 on the 61st post from the token in a minute. The stand-in received nothing. Outside the live service (staging and local, by the environment name) every form is refused before any CRM call with the reason the window shows, so a site tried on staging never writes to the brokerage whose office staging reads (question 152, built with 155). The server door checks the bot check’s proof the window earned, which the site’s server passes on in X-Core-Human: 403 without it or with one that fails, before any lookup; the live service with no bot check set up answers 503 to every form and reports it, so it never takes a form unchecked (known bug 4); the site’s server reads the check’s public key with its token.
